يزدقموا (form VIII)
# يَزْدَقِمُوا (yazdaqimū) /jaz.da.qi.muː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِزْدَقَمَ (izdaqama)
# يُزْدَقَمُوا (yuzdaqamū) /juz.da.qa.muː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِزْدَقَمَ (izdaqama)
